title: Practical issues toward high-voltage aqueous rechargeable batteries
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,4200-4313
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS00779D, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Seongjae Ko, Shin-ichi Nishimura, Norio Takenaka, Atsushi Kitada, Atsuo Yamada
This review critically examines high-voltage aqueous rechargeable batteries, focusing on challenges in electrolytes, interphases, electrodes, assessment techniques, and misunderstood/overlooked degradation chemistry and drawbacks.
